summary.en: Kenyan-led forces and Erik Prince's contractors are using drones and air support to strike gang positions in Port-au-Prince and Kenscoff, while Sri Lankan police, army and a Bangladesh UN advance team have been deployed to Haiti. The United Nations renewed sanctions on Haiti and allocated US$75 million for life-saving aid to 507,000 people. Four soldiers are missing after a gang attack and five Salvadoran soldiers disappeared following an ambush, showing continued threats to foreign troops. Elections remain on hold as gangs adapt to the security crackdown, and 193 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Kenyanske styrker og Erik Princes entreprenører bruker droner og luftstøtte for å angripe gjengposisjoner i Port-au-Prince og Kenscoff, mens srilankanske politiet, hæren og et bangladeshisk FN-fremrykkende team er blitt utplassert til Haiti. De forente nasjoner fornyet sanksjonene mot Haiti og avsatte US$75 millioner til livreddende hjelp til 507 000 personer. Fire soldater er savnet etter et gjengeangrep og fem salvadoranske soldater forsvant etter et bakholdsangrep, noe som viser vedvarende trusler mot utenlandske tropper. Valgene forblir på vent mens gjengene tilpasser seg sikkerhetsnedslagene, og 193 dødsfall i kamp ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
